=== .ddev/commands/web/pushDump ===
#!/bin/bash

# set -x
set -eou pipefail

DUMP_LOCATION=dump/db.sql
dump_file=""

REMOTE_HOST=***REMOVED***
REMOTE_DUMP_LOCATION="/html/tfm-fachplanung/db.sql"
REMOTE_CONFIG_FILE="/html/tfm-fachplanung/SecretConfiguration.php"

DB_PASSW_CMD=""

REMOTE_DB_HOST=db001155.mydbserver.com
REMOTE_DB_USER=p620627
REMOTE_DB_NAME=usr_p620627_1
REMOTE_DB_PASSWORD=""

while getopts :f: flag
do
    case "${flag}" in
        f) dump_file=${OPTARG};;
        *)
            if [ "$OPTERR" != 1 ] || [ "${optspec:0:1}" = ":" ]; then
               echo "Non-option argument: '-${OPTARG}'" >&2
            fi
            ;;
    esac
done

#mysqldump -uroot -proot db >dump/db.sql
if [ -z "$dump_file" ]; then
    mysqldump -uroot -proot db > dump/db.sql
else
    DUMP_LOCATION="$dump_file"
fi

## Push dump to Remote host
rsync -az --info=progress2 $DUMP_LOCATION $REMOTE_HOST:$REMOTE_DUMP_LOCATION

## Get for REMOTE_DB_PASSWORD
REMOTE_DB_PASSWORD=$(ssh $REMOTE_HOST "sed -n \"s/^.*'password'\s=>\s'\(.*\)',$/\1/p\" $REMOTE_CONFIG_FILE")

## Import dump on Remote host
ssh $REMOTE_HOST "mysql --host=$REMOTE_DB_HOST -u$REMOTE_DB_USER -p$REMOTE_DB_PASSWORD $REMOTE_DB_NAME < $REMOTE_DUMP_LOCATION"

=== .ddev/commands/web/surf ===
#!/bin/bash

## Description: Run TYPO3/Surf commands in ddev-container
## Usage: surf
## Example: "ddev surf deploy current"

set -euo pipefail

# install surf
if ! composer global exec surf
then
  echo "surf could not be found. installing"
  composer global require typo3/surf
fi

# run it
export COMMIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse HEAD)

composer global exec "surf --configurationPath=Build/Surf/ $@"
